decisive_spans.text: A young girl initially came under care at age 4 years
Shows a compound nevus with large nested melanocytes and bridging at the dermal-epidermal junction consistent with an atypical compound nevus
Shows atypical nevus with areas of dermal fibrosis
A large, dark brown patch consisting of coalescing macules and satellite lesions
The patch shows areas of regression on the medial and left upper borders

response.rationale: The vignette describes a lesion present since age 4, growing over time, with satellite lesions and areas of regression, and histopathology consistent with an atypical compound nevus with dermal fibrosis. These features strongly support Congenital Melanocytic Nevus. Atypical Compound Nevus is also supported by histopathology but lacks the comprehensive picture of a congenital lesion with growth and regression.
